verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an MCP connection and registry platform, but the evidence shows no documented bulk or batch capability. The CLI and REST interface describe single-item actions, such as adding one connection or calling one tool. Aggregating tools from multiple servers is an adjacent feature, not bulk execution across many items, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
